answer.rationale: Roll out the confirmed shortened, simplified onboarding for SMB/self-serve accounts. It improves completion, speeds time-to-value, and has demonstrated a positive 30-day retention effect, supporting sustainable qualified revenue without attracting a discount-dependent cohort. Do not counter the competitor with broad promotional pricing: the recovered price-sensitive SMB test raised signup and near-term revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, making it unsuitable for the primary objective. This does not directly resolve every price-driven churn conversation, so uncertainty remains until pricing pressure can be evaluated further next cycle.
